verdict.rationale: Navan documents an official MCP server for querying spend and travel data in natural language, with concrete example prompts, policy and approval questions, and card lookups. Its Ava assistant answers natural-language T&E analysis questions. Navan Edge accepts chat-based booking, change and cancel requests, asking for explicit confirmation before acting. Missing for 10: evidence that natural-language commands can perform write actions across expenses and cards (MCP evidence is mostly query/read), broad availability (Edge is reserved for frequent travelers), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
